description: Expected class correspondences between the ModelCVS Ecore and UML 2.0 class-diagram metamodels (Kessentini et al. 2014, model exchange case). Recreated by hand because the original reference alignments are lost; seeded by the paper's Fig. 1-3 (EClass-Class, EAttribute/EReference-Property) and completed from the Ecore and UML 2.0 specifications.
uncertain: ecore.ETypedElement -> uml2CD.MultiplicityElement (Ecore puts bounds on ETypedElement, UML on MultiplicityElement)
ecore.EClassifier -> uml2CD.Type (UML splits Ecore's EClassifier into Type and Classifier)
ecore.EDataType -> uml2CD.PrimitiveType (Ecore has no separate primitive type class)
ecore.EAnnotation -> uml2CD.Comment (annotations carry key/value details, comments only text)

unmatched.note: No UML 2.0 class-diagram concept corresponds to these Ecore classes.
